summary: Practise psychosocial hazard assessment, controls and monitoring with ISO 45003. Explore the course and strengthen your workplace OHS processes.
lede: Psychosocial risk management under ISO 45003 links workplace hazard assessment and controls with an occupational health and safety management system. For OHS managers, HR leaders and safety representatives, the course covers building hazard registers, consulting workers and prioritizing risks. You will practise selecting controls and setting monitoring measures for workload, fatigue, harassment and remote or hybrid work, then documenting decisions within existing ISO 45001 processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess work-related psychosocial hazards, advise leaders on prevention or maintain the records that connect worker concerns to OHS controls.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with occupational health and safety processes, people management or employee relations is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
